decisions.reason: As a German machinery maker, we would usually give a newly launched stand-alone industrial system several years to build demand, and the lack of archived pages after 2019 is too weak a signal on its own to justify withdrawal.
A hydrocyclone coolant filter fits a stable, technical process-equipment portfolio, so absent clear evidence of poor sales or technical problems we would normally retain it in the range.

A gravity band coolant filter is also a core-type industrial filtration product with typically long commercial lives in machinery markets, so management would be more likely to keep than discontinue it in 2022.
